summary.text: Andrew Server is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A high school teacher, he advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, in which he defeated Seth Bard.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Server graduated from Chaparral High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 2016 and an additional certification there in 2018.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Parker, Colorado, earned a degree in political science, and later returned to the University of Wyoming for a degree in secondary education to teach social studies.
He said he works as a high school teacher and, in the summer, as a roadway construction inspector and materials technician, and that his family moved to Cheyenne in 2023.
Server said in the survey that his campaign messages center on individual freedom and a business-friendly state, including school choice, secure property rights and lean taxes.

He also said Wyoming should clarify local codes and agreements with businesses, such as data center developers, to protect residents from water overuse, waste contamination and eminent domain concerns.
